name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois's journey into motorsport began in her father's garage, where she spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the intricacies of mechanical systems. Her passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which she worked for several years in the automotive industry, honing her fabrication skills. Dissatisfied with the limitations of mass production, Sophie sought a more challenging and dynamic environment, ultimately joining MP Motorsport Junior as a fabricator.

Sophie is known for her pragmatic approach and meticulous attention to detail. She excels at translating complex engineering designs into tangible, high-performance components. Her colleagues admire her ability to quickly identify and resolve technical issues, ensuring that the team's cars are always in optimal condition. Sophie's loyalty and commitment to the team make her an invaluable asset. She believes in a holistic approach to vehicle construction, always considering how each component contributes to the overall performance and reliability of the car.

What sets Sophie apart is her ability to balance technical expertise with a practical, real-world understanding of what works on the track. She isn't afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is always looking for innovative ways to improve the team's performance. Her big-picture thinking, combined with her hands-on fabrication skills, make her a unique and highly valued member of the MP Motorsport Junior team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sophie is of average height, with a lean build and strong, capable hands.

quirks: Always has a small notebook and pen in her pocket, jotting down ideas and observations.
Refuses to work on a dirty workbench; cleanliness is paramount.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on complex tasks.
